'''Najiba''' was the [[Najib]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. It was a remote [[Planet/Legends|world]] covered with wetlands and its surface was lashed with atmospheric electrical discharges and frequent rainstorms.

==History==
Najiba was a backwater world with a considerable degree of criminal activity. It was located a mere one-hour's [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel from the [[Trulalis system|Issor system]]. During one half of its elliptical [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], Najiba passed near a hazardous [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|belt]] known as the "[[Children of Najiba]]," at which time all travel to and from the planet was restricted. The [[Byzal Canyon]] was a canyon located on Najiba that was very popular with [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|racers]].

Prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Adalric Cessius Brandl]] hired the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Thaddeus Ross]] to take him from Najiba to [[Trulalis]], Brandl's former home.
